pseudos.text: Intuit, the tax-software company, is undergoing a significant restructuring to strengthen collaboration and pioneer new technology in artificial intelligence. To achieve this, the CEO communicated the difficult but necessary changes to staff, which include a significant but focused reduction to refocus the company, eliminating approximately 3,000 full-time roles. Affected U.S. employees are being provided a supportive severance package to ease their transition, and operations in Reno and Woodland Hills are transitioning to more central locations as part of the company's future-focused strategy.

After months of internal review, the company pursuing a focused strategy announced a plan to co-locate teams in strategic hubs and accelerate AI-driven product work. This plan involves offering a path forward through a thoughtful transition, where valued team members facing transition will receive a defined severance plan to support them. Offices in Reno and Woodland Hills are winding down as operations consolidate into key hubs for future growth.
